# Yina Goes

> > A personal travel and lifestyle blog by Yina Goh documenting adventures across Asia and Europe, personal reflections, and creative projects.

Yina Goes chronicles travel experiences spanning Japan, Bhutan, Prague, and Southeast Asia, alongside candid personal essays on relationships, self-discovery, and entrepreneurial ventures including TheVelvetDolls (TVD). The blog blends detailed travel itineraries with photography, lifestyle reviews, and authentic storytelling.

## Key Topics

- Travel photography
- Japan travel (Osaka, Hokkaido)
- Personal storytelling and life updates
- Singapore lifestyle
- Relationship and marriage reflections
- Bhutan adventure travel
- Europe travel (Prague)
- TheVelvetDolls (TVD) business
- Samsung NX3000 photography
- Southeast Asia destinations
- Self-love and personal growth
- Beauty and wellness reviews
- Road trip itineraries
- Cultural experiences
